about.title: Developer mindset. Designer eye.
paragraphs: Hello! I’m Nithin S P, a Full Stack Developer and Graphic Designer passionate about technology, web development, and creating things that solve real problems.
I enjoy learning by building projects and exploring new technologies. I combine technical knowledge with an eye for visual design to create experiences that are useful, responsive, and engaging.
I’m looking for an opportunity where I can learn from experienced teams, contribute to real-world projects, and grow as a developer while creating meaningful work.
